summary_en: Ehime Bank raised its full-year dividend forecast to 24 yen per share from 20 yen, reflecting improved earnings expectations. The revision represents a 4 yen increase per share.
title_en: Notice of Revision to Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Ehime Bank announced a revision to its earnings forecast for the fiscal year, resulting in an upward revision of its dividend policy. The bank increased its full-year dividend per share forecast from the previously announced 20 yen to 24 yen, representing an increase of 4 yen per share. This dividend hike reflects the company's improved profit outlook and updated earnings expectations for the current fiscal year.
